text: Hi sorry, I'm babysitting my little sister (she's 10) and she whacked her head on the corner of the kitchen table about half an hour ago. She cried straight away, like proper loud, then calmed down after a few minutes. Now she's literally completely normal, watching telly and arguing with me lol. She hasn't had any fit or shaking or anything. Our parents are out and I didn't want to ring them for nothing. Sorry if this is a waste of your time, I just wanted to check I don't need to do anything
